content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial concerns missing required prior authorization; retroactive authorization and peer-to-peer review are not available under this payer's rules. Eligibility, coding, and COB are valid, so correcting or resubmitting the claim would not address the denial. A formal medical-necessity appeal is available because a denial is on the table and can use the supporting clinical documentation without improperly shifting the balance to the patient.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
